_source: EASI-Leaderboard-Data TSV (lmms-lab-si); vlmeval class MMSIVideoBench. 64 frames: kit variant MMSIVideoBench_64frame; paper's Sufficient-Coverage policy is 300 frames (kit variant _300frame) - too long for the 24 GB-GPU serving budget, see TODO.md
_frames: MMSIVideoBench.build_prompt never sends a video message: it subsamples the provided per-clip frame lists with the DATASET's nframe (global linspace over all segments) and sends them as images, so frames are set here and there is no video_sampling block (client-side sampling is not used). Verified by scripts/check_video_sampling.py.
